item.text:
Built the responsive course registration app in `/work`. The four pages—[Home](</work/index.html>), [Course Catalog](</work/catalog.html>), [Registration](</work/registration.html>), and [My Profile](</work/profile.html>)—share a colorful design and link through the navigation bar.

The catalog includes 12 sample courses, search, and department and level filters. Registration shows a confirmation modal and saves courses in `localStorage`; the profile displays the registered courses and credit total.

I checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check app.js`. I couldn’t verify browser console behavior because no browser tool is available.
